user.title: Add a radmon.org station
user.description:
Enter the station name exactly as it appears in the [station list]({stations_url}).

**Your own station?** Also enter its data-sending password. Owner mode uses radmon.org's official last-reading API, which needs this password since May 2026, and gives the station's own µSv/h value.

**Someone else's station?** Leave the password empty. The public station page is read every 30 minutes and the dose rate is calculated from CPM.

data_description.password: The password your Geiger counter uses to submit readings. Only for your own station.

reauth_confirm.title: New data-sending password
reauth_confirm.description: radmon.org rejected the data-sending password for station {station}. Enter the current one.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection for {station}
reconfigure.description: Enter the data-sending password to use owner mode, or leave it empty to read the public station page.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach radmon.org. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: radmon.org rejected the station name or data-sending password.
error.station_not_found: This station has no readings on radmon.org. Check the spelling (names are case-sensitive).
error.invalid_response: radmon.org returned something unexpected. Try again later.

init.title: Radmon options
init.description: Mode: {mode}. The minimum update interval in this mode is {min_interval} minutes, to go easy on radmon.org.

data_description.conversion_factor: Used to calculate the dose rate from CPM. 0.0057 suits an SBM-20 tube. In owner mode the station's own µSv/h value is used when available.
data_description.alert_threshold: The alert binary sensor turns on at or above this CPM.
data_description.stale_minutes: The online binary sensor turns off when the last reading is older than this.
